CFDictionarySetValue(classesToMatch, CFSTR(kIOSerialBSDTypeKey), CFSTR(kIOSerialBSDModemType)); } // Get an iterator across all matching devices. kernResult = IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMasterPortDefault, classesToMatch, matchingServices); ```
